rejectedNotes: Book 'Make Something Wonderful' (book.stevejobsarchive.com) is one page; split into 25 sections written as sources/essay-msw-*.md and merged into sources.json after fetch (fetch's slugify ignores URL fragments, so they can't go in pages[]). Skipped book's Aspen and D5 excerpts (full versions used instead), preface and editor's notes (not his words). Archive artifact pages are image scans with captions only. Skipped Lost Interview video (full text transcript used), Stanford 2005 videos (book text used), WWDC 1997 videos (text transcript used), Smithsonian/WGBH 1990 videos (text used), 1997 staff meeting video (book text), keynotes that are spec demos, documentaries and articles about him (Isaacson, a16z, Business Insider, Times of India, Medium), multi-part split uploads and foreign-dub duplicates.
gaps: Playboy-style long magazine Q&As from Fortune archive (1991, 1998, 2000) blocked
PBS Triumph of the Nerds broadcast transcript not used (raw interview used instead)
Inc. 1989, BusinessWeek 2004 and Access 1984 Q&As are paywalled or truncated; dropped
